question: Revenue month-to-date
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM catalog.schema.orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
generated_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM catalog.schema.orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY
judge_rationale: Used trailing-30-day window instead of month-to-date
expected_repair_hypothesis: Replace trailing-30 with MTD using DATE_TRUNC
